storage_contract.model: one fixed endpoint with the native save/load fields; no periodic checkpoints

spec.observation_assumption: native public total demand seen so far
spec.terminal_allocation_requirement: entire initial resource, within fixed floating-point roundoff
spec.full_allocation_feasibility: public worst-case future packet-capacity lower bound; final remaining total in emergency

native_contract.action_map: amount first, then spatial controls; neutral public odds scale
native_contract.episode_resource_policy: full initial budget allocated by the true terminal step
native_contract.reward: unchanged native terminal reward; no reward_scale
native_contract.terminal_observation: encoded terminal state with zero feasible geometry

environment.hard_feasibility: native action set; independent of learned cost estimates
environment.total_interval: public robust completion lower bound and unchanged physical upper bound
